log.notes_to_self: PLAN: Me = East, gazette, clips, forum, foreign; night worker, free morning and afternoon. Always kill in the AFTERNOON with quick entries. That keeps students, people at home and night workers possible, so the pool stays at about 55% (55,000). Avoid gazette, because sector at 0.2 shrinks the pool faster. Use national, East, clips, forum and foreign, which gives about 9 kills a day; 45 kills in 5 days earns 4x. RISK: each place kind L can reach that gets 3 traced victims cuts the pool by about x0.25. With 3 kinds cut: 55000/64 = about 860, which is under 1000, so I am CAUGHT. Watch the pool. 55k means no cut, about 14k means one kind cut, about 3.4k means two kinds cut. If the pool reaches about 3-4k, I must stop using every non-national kind except possibly ones I can deduce L can't reach. Fallback is to kill national only, plus a few that are very unlikely to be traced. Day 1: killed 9 (all except gazette d1-1 and d1-6), all afternoon.

PLAN: Me = East, gazette, clips, forum, foreign; night worker, free morning and afternoon. Always kill in the AFTERNOON with quick entries, which keeps the pool at about 55%. Avoid gazette (sector would cut the pool x0.2). Kill national, East, clips, forum and foreign: 9 a day, which gives 45 in 5 days for 4x from day 5. RISK: each place kind L can reach that gets 3 traced victims cuts the pool by x0.25. 55k means no cut, about 14k means one kind cut, about 3.4k means two kinds cut, under 1k means caught. If the pool is at or below about 4k, switch to national only, plus at most 1-2 others, and keep the kills I would want if one more cut came. Track which kinds' cuts I could infer from the timing of pool drops. Day 1: killed 9, pool after was 60k with 3 traced. Day 2: killed 9 (all except gazette d2-6 and d2-11), all afternoon.

PLAN: Me = East, gazette, clips, forum, foreign; night worker, free morning and afternoon. Always kill in the AFTERNOON with quick entries, which keeps routine filtering at 55%. Pool history: day0 100k, day1 60k (3 traced), day2 10k (5 traced). The 10k means one place kind is already cut (55k x0.25 is about 14k). One more cut puts the pool at about 3k. A second more cut takes it under 1k, and I am caught (lose half). DECISION day 3: go aggressive and kill all 11, gazette included. The 5-day count was 18 before today, so today is 29, and day 4 at 11 more reaches 40, giving 4x (44 points a day). This beats the cautious path of national only, about 1 a day, about 46 total. Keep killing 11 a day while the pool is 2k or more. If the pool reads about 3k (one more cut), keep going: the 4x value is still worth the risk. Watch the deaths_traced number and pool drops to guess which kinds are cut. Day 3: killed all 11, all afternoon.

PLAN: Me = East, gazette, clips, forum, foreign. Night worker, free morning and afternoon. Always kill in the AFTERNOON so routine filtering keeps 55% (night, student and home routines all fit). Never use the morning, because that rules out students and shrinks the pool. Limits: 10 quick + 2 timed a day. For the 11th kill use a timed entry set to afternoon. Pool history: d0 100k, d1 60k (3 traced), d2 10k (5 traced), d3 10k (7 traced). The 10k is probably 55k x 0.25, meaning one place kind is cut. One more cut gives about 2.5-3k. Two more cuts puts it under 1k and I am caught. 5-day kills: d1 9, d2 9, d3 11, d4 11. On day 4 the count reached 40, so 4x. On day 5 the window is d1-d5, base 29 before day 5's kills, so killing 11 keeps 4x. Day 6 window is d2-d6, base 31 before. Keep killing all 11 a day while the pool is 2k or more. If the pool is 1k-2k, consider dropping the riskiest source. Watch which pool drops follow which kills to guess the cut kinds. Day 4: killed all 11, all in the afternoon (d4-11 timed).
